findings.issue: openEnderStart calls rankMask(hole) twice (for holeOnly and present).
findings.evidence: const holeOnly = rankMask(hole) & ~onBoard; const present = rankMask(hole) | onBoard;
findings.fix: Keep `const fromHole = rankMask(hole);` and derive holeOnly = fromHole & ~onBoard, present = fromHole | onBoard.

findings.issue: The edited 'has no outs, and a hero who already has a flush or a straight...' line is much longer than the surrounding ~100-column wrapped prose.
findings.evidence: Line 42 runs well past the wrap width used by neighbouring lines in the same bullet.
findings.fix: Re-wrap the paragraph to match the surrounding line width.

summary: All seven SPEC items are implemented as specified. openEnderStart now requires a hole-only rank (rankMask(hole) & ~rankMask(board)) inside the run, and drawOuts skips straight outs when any suit has 5+ cards. The tests would catch a regression: under the old rule AC#1 and the 7c 2d unit case would return 8 outs, and without the made-flush guard AC#3 and the 9h 8c turn-flush case would return the 5s/Ts or 7s/Ts. SPEC-05 is a regression check that passes under both rules by design (D-1). The build log has the before/after playtest SHA (after matches the prototype, 0 invariant violations) and all 12 style-band lines. Scope is the 4 spec'd files, about 67 lines. The targeted tests pass (21/21). Only two NITs.
